channel.title: The Argo: the house of rhynotic.eth
channel.description: What happened to the Argonauts and Leaves of one house.

item.title: Chthonchles Andrmedides ~2577 died before their time and walks the lanes of Pagasae & the
item.description: Chthonchles Andrmedides ~2577 died before their time and walks the lanes of Pagasae & the Agora at dusk, one of the aōroi, the too-soon dead.

item.title: The fire under Chthonchles Andrmedides ~2577 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an
item.description: The fire under Chthonchles Andrmedides ~2577 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an oar was planted on the mound in the Asphodel Meadow.

item.title: Chthonchles Andrmedides ~2577 lived only 1 years. As is the generation of leaves, so is th
item.description: Chthonchles Andrmedides ~2577 lived only 1 years. As is the generation of leaves, so is that of men.

item.title: Kleippo Andrmedides ~2551 was born in the Field of Ares to Andrmedes #8222 the Twice-Born
item.description: Kleippo Andrmedides ~2551 was born in the Field of Ares to Andrmedes #8222 the Twice-Born and Chrysope Hypsnikides ~20.

item.title: Andrmedes #8222 the Twice-Born carved Chrysope Hypsnikides ~20's name into a rib-bone and
item.description: Andrmedes #8222 the Twice-Born carved Chrysope Hypsnikides ~20's name into a rib-bone and gave it away. They walk together at dusk now.
